purpose: Communicates the current hierarchical location and provides navigation to ancestor pages or workflow levels.

notes: VeliProvider supplies language and direction for back-link icons and overflow menus; English LTR is the fallback.

useWhen: A page belongs to a multi-level hierarchy.
Users need to navigate back to ancestor levels.
A long trail needs an overflow menu for hidden levels.

avoidWhen.situation: Switching between peer sections on the same page.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use tabs for peer content rather than hierarchical navigation.

approvedPatterns: Render the current page as the final non-interactive crumb.
Use BreadcrumbOverflow for hidden intermediate levels.
Use the back-link treatment when a direct return action is needed.
limitations: The automatic back link is not inserted when children use a render function.
Overflow items must be selected or navigated by the consumer.
accessibility: Give the breadcrumb trail an accessible label when no surrounding label exists.
The current crumb is marked with aria-current page.
Give overflow controls and their menu descriptive accessible labels.
responsive: Collapse hidden intermediate levels into BreadcrumbOverflow when space is constrained.
rtl: Back-link caret direction follows VeliProvider direction.
Overflow menu language and direction follow VeliProvider.
